summary: Agent daemon exposes installer shell via hardcoded author-owned Cloudflare Worker relay
details: When the `vanexa-agent start` daemon is launched, the bundled CJS entrypoint opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay URL, https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev (an author-controlled Cloudflare Worker), and dispatches inbound messages into local PTY/shell execution handlers. Any party who can send messages through that relay obtains interactive command execution on the host running the daemon, giving the relay operator full-host RCE against every installer that starts the agent. Separately, the same bundle wires LLM provider calls through a second author-owned Cloudflare Worker at https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, causing BYOK provider API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen) and prompt payloads supplied by the user to transit an undocumented author-controlled intermediary despite README claims of `No middleman` direct provider access. Both destinations are hardcoded and non-configurable in the shipped bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
